title: Modular exponentiation step
statement: For a Boolean-list state $S$, return $S$ unchanged if the first component of its second component is empty or the natural number encoded by the first component of $S$ is zero. Otherwise, update the encoded state using the displayed list operations: drop the first bit of that exponent component, compute the indicated products and remainders using the components of $S$, and choose the final remainder according to the first bit of the exponent component.
caveat: The snippet does not define the pair encoding, projections, or the multiplication and remainder routines, so the state update cannot be rendered more explicitly as mathematics.
